test_case.test_name: VP8 hardware decode, keyframe/frame integrity and physical display
test_case.purpose: Validate the approved VP8 stream is hardware-decoded on the exact GPU with complete VP8-specific frame/keyframe integrity and displayed on the approved connector without corruption or edge artifacts, independently of VP9.
required_package: Immutable approved VP8 WebM/Matroska or IVF input and SHA-256; expected 8-bit 4:2:0, coded/display dimensions, rate/time base, duration/frame count and keyframe map
Golden decoded `framemd5`, expected timestamps and pinned output pixel format
Exact GPU serial/UUID/BDF, driver/VBIOS and ffmpeg/ffprobe build with approved VP8 NVDEC path, capability query and no-fallback logging
Bounded non-production scratch/evidence root; approved connector/display/mode/player/capture route and qualified visual operator
Approved health/event thresholds, abort criteria and non-destructive recovery
test_case.test_command: PARAMETERIZED REVIEW-LAYER PROCEDURE — do not execute without approved bindings. Verify input/golden hashes, capacity, exact GPU capability and baseline while preserving logs. Record `ffprobe -v error -show_streams -show_format -show_frames -select_streams v:0 -of json "$VP8_INPUT"`; require VP8 codec, approved container, 8-bit 4:2:0, dimensions, time base, duration/frame count and keyframe map. Record ffmpeg build and decoder/hardware capabilities. Run `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel repeat+level+verbose -hwaccel "$APPROVED_HWACCEL" -hwaccel_device "$GPU_SELECTOR" -i "$VP8_INPUT" -map 0:v:0 -an -vf "$APPROVED_HW_DOWNLOAD_AND_PIXEL_FORMAT" -f framemd5 "$VP8_ACTUAL_FRAMEMD5"`; require bound hardware decode/no fallback and exact VP8 golden/timestamp match. Play the complete same input through the approved physical route and collect full-clip time-correlated visual evidence. Collect final health/events, stop on anomaly and do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: The VP8 input/golden hashes and stream/keyframe metadata match; the bound hardware VP8 decoder is proven without fallback; all expected frames/timestamps/signatures match and ffmpeg exits 0 without parser/decode errors. Complete connector-bound playback has no block corruption, missing/frozen frames, tearing, wrong crop/aspect/color or edge artifact; health/events remain within limits. Evidence is unique to VP8 and this Source Key.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when all VP8 capability, input/keyframe, frame-signature, health and qualified visual checks pass. FAIL on libvpx/software substitution, VP9 evidence reuse, fallback, wrong stream/GPU, keyframe/timestamp/frame/signature mismatch, truncated playback, visual defect, nonzero exit or health breach. BLOCKED at runtime—not Engineering Decision Pending—if approved media/golden/device/display/operator/package/threshold bindings are missing. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Reject CPU `libvpx` encode-to-null and VP9 artifacts as VP8 decode evidence; prove exact hardware decoder/no fallback.
Verify immutable VP8 input/golden/keyframe contract before workload and tag every artifact with this Source Key/Variant.
Use only approved bounded scratch/evidence paths and the complete configured clip; preserve logs/events.
Keep deterministic decoded-frame checks separate from real connector-bound visual proof.
Stop on media, decoder, GPU/driver/Xid, thermal/power, storage, display or evidence anomaly; do not retry, reset, reboot, clear logs or alter firmware automatically.
expected_evidence: VP8-only input/golden hashes, ffprobe container/codec/pixel/dimension/rate/time-base/frame/keyframe metadata and approved bindings
Exact GPU/driver/VBIOS/ffmpeg identities, VP8 capability, hardware decoder selection and no-fallback verbose log
Complete exit status, timestamp/frame/keyframe accounting, actual `framemd5` and exact VP8 golden comparison
Connector/display/mode/player identity and full-clip time-correlated visual record with qualified operator checklist
Source Key/Variant tagging, no VP9 evidence reuse, scratch/capacity and pre/during/post health/events, no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop the VP8 decoder/player on first failure, preserve VP8-only input, manifests, logs, captures and events and do not retry. Remove only approved scratch after retention and restore only approved display/session state without reset, reboot or firmware action; escalate if health remains abnormal.
